book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Yesu kanguyingila ku Yelusalemu kwa Chekwa
Yesu na ahundwa bhake pabhaheghelelite kuhika ku Yelusalemu, bhakihika ku Betifage mukitumbi kya Miseituni, apo kakialaghila ahundwa bhake abhili,
kakiaghombela, “Nng'ende mbaka ku kijiji kiibheghite muulongolo ghwenu, maammona kaputa kabhopwa, na mwana ywake kabhopwa pambwegha, muabhopole na mubhayeghe kwa nenga.
Handa mundu pakabhakonya kiyaha niki munguatola, munnyange, ‘Bambo kanguapala,’ kamu, kataabhuyiha.”
Nnando aghu ghukitendekwa ngati ghatwihilike ghala ghaalongelitwe na mbuye,

content.text: Ndo mpole na ywakahika katama unane mwa kaputa,
unane na mwa kaputa, mwana ywa kaputa.”

content: Habhu, bhala ahundwa bhakighenda kutenda handa paalaghilitwe na Yesu.
Bhakinnyegha yula kaputa na mwana ywake, bhakiyalila ngubho hyabhe mu mighongo yabhe na Yesu kakitama kunane mwabhe.
Lumati lukulu lwa bhandu lukiyalila ngubho hyabhe munjila, na bhandu bhangi bhakidumula hiputila gha mikongo na kuhiyalila munjila.
Lumati lwa bhandu hiilongohanite na bhala bhaantughilite bhakikweha malobhe, “Katikilwe Mwana ywa Daudi. Yunakunemelwa ndo aywo ywakuhika kwa lihina lya Bambo. Tiko kwa Chapanga kunane.”
Yesu pakayingilite ku Yelusalemu, kitami kyoha kikibhegha na mbilingembilinge, bhandu bhakibhegha bhangukonya “Ayu ndo ghani?”
Bhandu mulula lumati bhakilongela, “Ayu ndo Yesu, mbuye kuhuma ku Nasaleti kitami kya Galilaya.”
Yesu kanguabhingabhinga achuhusa Munyumba ya Chapanga

Basi, Yesu kakiyingila pahala pa Nyumba ya Chapanga, na kakiabhingabhinga bhoha bhaabheghite mu kuhemela na kuchuhusa hilibhi mu Nyumba ya Chapanga, kakihipalangula hindambi hya bhala bhaabheghite mukuhemengana ngalabha na hiteho hya bhanakuhemengana ngunda.
Kakiaghombela “Yityekwa mu malembo gha Chapanga, ‘Nyumba yangu yibhegha nyumba kya kutundamila.’ Peni mwenga mukitenda kibheghe mbaku ya apoka.”
Bhangalola na bhanautebhalo bhakinng'endela ku Nyumba ya Chapanga, naywo Yesu kakialamiha.

Basi, akulu bha andundame na ahunda bha Malaghilo paabhonite milando yakatendite Yesu, na kuayihwa bhana paalumbilila pahala pa Nyumba ya Chapanga paalongela, “Tuntike Mwana ywa Daudi.” Bhombe bhakikalala.

Bhakinkonya Yesu, “Bhuli, ghunguyihwa agho ghaaghalongela?” Yesu kakiaghombela, “Ena nunguyihwa! Bhuli, mukisoma ng'obhe Malembo gha Chapanga? ‘Kwa ngulo ya bhana adoko na hing'enya ghubhakwilikiha bhakutike kwa utwihiliko?’ ”
Basi, kakialeka, kakibhuka panji ya kitami na kakighenda ku kijiji kya Betania na kakighonja akwo.
Yesu kangughukotola nkongo ghuukemwa Ntini
Yesu pakabheghite kangubhuya kumbwani malabhila putiputi, njala yikimmina.

Kakighubhona nkongo ghuukemwa Ntini pambwegha ya njila, kakighughendela, peni ghukibhegha ng'obhe na mapambika ngati ghukibhegha na mahamba ghweka. Basi, kakighughombela ghula nkongo, “Ghukotoke kupambika mapambika kangi.” Pala pala ghula nkongo ghukinyaluka.
Ahundwa bhake paabhonite nnando aghu bhakikangacha, bhakinkonya, paalongela, “Yibhegha bhuli nkongo aghu ghwa ntini ghunyaluke kanongola?”

Yesu kakiaghombela, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, handa panhyubhalila na nkotoke kubhegha na bhwaghalili, maahotola, chepa ghweka kutenda habhu, ngati hata pamukighombela kitumbi aki, ‘Ghutupuke ghukalitaghe ku lihibha.’ Yaakitendeka habho.
Na lyohele limulipala kuyupa mumayupo, malikingama.”
Yesu kangukonywa yakya Likalama lyake

Yesu kakiyingila pahala pa Nyumba ya Chapanga, kakiyanda kuhunda, mandundame akulu na hilongohi bha aghohi bhakinhikila na bhakinkonya, “Ghungutenda milando ayi kwa makakala gha ghani? Na ghani ywakakupeghite makakala agha?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Na nenga ndabhakonya likonyo limu, pamunyanga, na nenga ndabhaghombela ndo kwa likalama lyoki nungutenda milando ayi.

Ubatisa ghakihuma kwa ghani? Bhuli, ghakihuma kwa kunane ebu kwa bhandu?” Bhakiyanda kughombana bhombe kwa bhombe na kulongela, “Patulongela ghakihuma kunane katatukonya, ‘Kyabhuli mukinhyubhalila ng'obhe?’
Na patulongela, ‘Ghakihuma kwa bhandu.’ Yaabwituka bhulwa kiyaha bhandu abha bhoha bhanguhyubhalila kukita Yohane ndo mbuye ywa Chapanga.”
Habhu, bhakinnyanga, “Twenga tungumanya ng'obhe.” Naywo Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nenga bhubho ndabhaghombela ng'obhe ndo kwa likalama lyoki nungutenda milando ayi.”
Nhwano ghwa bhana abhili alume
“Basi, mwenga munguhwacha niki? Mundu yumu kakibhegha na bhana abhili. Kakinng'endela yula ywa kalongohi na kunng'ombela, ‘Mwana ywangu, lelo ghughende ghukatende lihengo munng'unda ghwa misabibu.’
Yula mwana kakinnyanga, ‘Nenga ndaaghenda ng'obhe,’ mbole kakikilibhuha mahwacho ghake kakighenda kutenda lihengo.
Yula tate kakinng'endela yula mwana ywa ubhili na kakinng'ombela bhula bhula. Ywombe kakinnyanga, ‘Ndaaghenda tate,’ peni kakighenda ng'obhe kutenda lihengo.

Ndo ywoki nkati ya abha abhili ywakannyitikilite kyakakipalite tate ywake?” Bhakinnyanga, “Yula ywa kalongohi.” Habhu, Yesu kakiaghombela, “Kulyaghila nenga nunguaghombela, asumula sumu na angongola bhataalongola kuyingila ku Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga.

Mana Yohane yunakubatisa kakihika kwa mwenga kuabhoneha njila ya hoto ya kutama, mwenga mukinhyubhalila ng'obhe, peni asumula sumu na angongola bhakinhyubhalila. Hata payibhele mwenga pammonite agho ghoha mukilipetula ng'obhe na kunhyubhalila.”
Nhwano ghwa akulima munng'unda ghwa misabibu

Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nnyihwe nhwano ghungi, mundu yumu nkola nng'unda kakilima nng'unda ghwa misabibu, kakighutindihila kindupa, kakikimba libhumba lya kukamila difwai. Kakichenga kinala kya ukingikiho. Mbole, kakiayahikila bhanakulima bhamu nng'unda aghwo ghwa misabibu, mwene kakibhuka kakitenda mwanja kughenda ku nnima ghungi.
Paghaheghelelite manjubha gha mabeno, kakialaghila andumindumi bhake kwa bhala akulima bhakaayahikilite, ngati apongole mafungu ghake gha mabeno.
Bhala bhaayahikilitwe bhakibhakamula bhala andumindumi, yumu bhakintuta, yungi bhakinkoma na yungi bhakintuta kwa malibho.
Nkola nng'unda aywo kakialaghila andumundumi bhangi atangalo kupitingana bha kalongohi, nabho bhala bhaayahikilitwe bhakiatendela bhula bhula.
Kuuhiko kakinlaghila mwana ywake kwa bhombe pakalongela, ‘Pangi bhatanhokamila mwana ywangu.’
Peni bhala bhaayahikilitwe paammonite mwana ywake bhakighombana bhombe kwa bhombe, ‘Ayu ndo yunakuhala. Hinu nhike na tunkome ngati tulitole lipala lyake.’
Habhu bhakinkamula, bhakinpiha panje ya nng'unda ghula na bhakinkoma.”
Yesu kaakonya, “Hinu, aywo nkola nng'unda ghwa misabibu pakapala kuhika katabhatenda niki bhala bhakaayahikilite nng'unda?”
Bhombe bhakinnyanga, “Kulyaghila katabhakoma bhandu abho ahokelo, mbole kataayahikila bhandu bhangi nng'unda aghwo bhene bhatampegha lusumulo lwake kwa nndaluko ghuutwihikilite.”
Apo Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mukisoma ng'obhe nnando mu Malembo?

content.text: Hinu lighalambuka na kubhegha libho likulu lya kitamiko
naghwo ndo nnando ghwa kukangaha muno kwa twenga!’ ”

content: Kya habhu nunguaghombela, “Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga ghwaabhuhwa kwa mwenga na kupeghwa bhandu bhangi bhanakutenda milando yakayipala Chapanga Mughubhutwa ghwake.”
Yesu kakighendelela kulongela “Mundu ywakapala kughwegha mulibho ali kaadumuka hipalamande palamande, na libho alyo palimponekela mundu, mundu aywo kaahyaghika.”
Mandundame akulu na Akaafalisayo paayihwite mihwano ya Yesu, bhaking'amula kukita kanguaghombela bhombe.
Kya habhu, bhakipalaha kihokonyo kya kunkamula, peni bhakiayoghopa bhandu kiyaha bhakimmanya Yesu kukita ndo mbuye ywa Chapanga.
